It is shown that long-term treatment with metformin starting at middle age extends healthspan and lifespan in male mice, while a higher dose (1% w/w) was toxic. Metformin is a drug commonly prescribed to treat patients with type 2 diabetes. Here we show that long-term treatment with metformin (0.1% w/w in diet) starting at middle age extends healthspan and lifespan in male mice, while a higher dose (1% w/w) was toxic.
